before.text: Operator note 2026-09-24: cocoaskills is a partial client that stays on the rc.10 core suite and adds only the accepted skillfile-sources; it will not adopt rc.11/rc.12 changes. The skillfile-sources text and vectors must stay consumable independently of rc.11/rc.12 core. Verified 2026-09-24 on main, 5470c04b (#89) and 916dd1c (#90): every schemas/v1 definition referenced from schemas/draft-sources-v1 (incl. agent-skill-v9/csk-skill-v9) is byte-identical at v1.0.0-rc.10; registry §3 identical, §4 deny-wins present at rc.10; draft vectors reference no rc.11/rc.12 concept. Add a CI gate that makes this a checked invariant: validate conformance/draft-sources-v1 (schema cases, semantic/snapshot index) against schemas/draft-sources-v1 + schemas/v1 taken from tag v1.0.0-rc.10, fail when a draft schema $ref resolves to a v1 definition absent or different at rc.10, and fail when protocol/skillfile-sources.md or repository-transport.md cites a core/registry/manager/environments clause introduced after rc.10. Also normalise the ../v1/../v1/ ref paths in the v9 manifest schemas if still present.

after.text: Operator decision: cocoaskills is a partial client (core v1.0.0-rc.10 + skillfile-sources-v1). curator-spec v1.0.0-rc.13 already pins conformance/skillfile-sources-v1 by its own manifest against core rc.10, and the Implementations CI checks cocoaskills against rc.10 + skillfile-sources-v1. Add a CI gate that keeps this independence a checked invariant: every $ref from schemas/skillfile-sources-v1 into schemas/v1 must resolve to a definition byte-identical at tag v1.0.0-rc.10 (fail on absent/different); protocol/skillfile-sources.md and repository-transport.md must not cite a core/registry/manager/environments clause introduced after rc.10 (an explicit informative-only marker allowed, see #96 review note N1); the gate runs in the existing Specification CI.
